crate_version.description: orbit-graph crate version that served the request; equals the plugin's metadata.version.

extractor_version.description: Code-graph extractor version; an index built by another version is not reused.

store_schema_version.description: SQLite schema version of the code-graph index.

history_schema_version.description: SQLite schema version of the change-history index.

plugin_schema_version.description: Version of the plugin request/response contract; requests must send the same schema_version.
